SFX Linux general-file transfer helper - November 8 2026

Separate executable, GPL-2.0-or-later. Original upstream/SFX notices and
licenses are retained. Origin: the accepted section10-file-helper materials,
recorded individually in LINUX_ORIGIN.json. Original Windows source is unchanged.
No ANet materials were used. No GPL helper code is linked into SFX Runtime.

Linux build entry: cmake/SfxLinuxFileTransfer.cmake in the SFX source tree.
The corresponding-source distribution must include this complete helper tree,
that build definition and standalone build instructions. This is distinct from
the runtime installation payload and from standalone Door source exclusions.

Linux changes:
 - Dedicated locked main; no generic SEXYZ argument, INI or environment discovery.
 - Private parent AF_UNIX stream with peer credentials; poll handles high FDs.
 - Monotonic deadlines, SIGPIPE handling, normal UID and no capability admission.
 - Fixed private job.cfg/result.txt, no following links or replacing receipts.
 - Payloads are inherited reduced-access FDs, validated before receipt creation;
   distinct descriptors must name distinct native objects. No payload path open.
 - POSIX descriptor/fsync/free-space operations replace the Windows primitives.
 - Existing strict protocol/CRC/EOF/batch completion and counted buffers retained.
 - Exact strict completion routines copied from this fork into the Linux include.
 - Unused generic CLI/event ring-buffer sources are excluded from Linux linking.
 - Function/data section collection removes unreachable generic helper routines.
 - genwrap random denominator cast precedes addition to avoid RAND_MAX overflow.

The helper does not authenticate a caller or publish/credit an upload. Runtime
must supervise deadlines/revocation, reserve actual storage, restrict inherited
FDs/capabilities, reap the child, verify exact relay/receipt/object evidence, then
perform its own durable intake/scan/acceptance transaction. A successful helper
test is not proof of the complete Runtime integration or antivirus behavior.

QWK packet executable addition, November 8 2026:
 - SFXQWKTransfer is a separate target with sfx_linux_qwk_main.c. General-file
   CLI, inherited-FD payload rules and its existing target remain unchanged.
 - The accepted packet receive/send state machines use the same strict end,
   CRC, one-file, REP/ZIP extension,16MiB and relay accounting rules.
 - Linux private AF_UNIX parent channel, normal UID/no capabilities, fixed
   private job names, no-follow/exclusive files and fsync replace Win32 APIs.
 - Include this additional source and CMake target in corresponding source.
   Packet validation, durable import and delivery progress belong to Runtime.
